# Julia launcher. Writes the files, then runs the Python orchestrator in the PyTorch venv.
using Base64
esc(s) = replace(s, "\\" => "\\\\", "\"" => "\\\"", "\n" => "\\n", "\r" => "", "\t" => " ")
try
    dir = mktempdir()
    files = Dict(
        "stade_case.jl" => "",
        "torch_case.py" => "",
        "orchestrate.py" => "",
        "bundle.jl" => "")
    for (k, v) in files
        write(joinpath(dir, k), base64decode(v))
    end
    errf = joinpath(dir, "orch.err")
    argstr = "c1 f64 1024,16384,262144,4194304 1e-10 bundle.jl"
    cmd = `bash -c "source /scratch/coop/drozda/torch-env/bin/activate && cd $dir && python orchestrate.py $argstr 2>$errf"`
    raw = read(ignorestatus(cmd), String)
    lines = filter(!isempty, strip.(split(raw, '\n')))
    if !isempty(lines) && startswith(last(lines), "{")
        println(last(lines))
    else
        err = isfile(errf) ? read(errf, String) : ""
        println("{\"error\":\"no JSON from orchestrator\",\"stdout\":\"", esc(raw[max(1, end-1500):end]), "\",\"stderr\":\"", esc(err[max(1, end-3000):end]), "\"}")
    end
catch e
    println("{\"error\":\"", esc(sprint(showerror, e)), "\"}")
end
